''You arrive at the beacon to find yourself dangerously close to a star. An automated Rebel ship, impervious to the heat, moves in to engage.''
*Fight an [[AI-Controlled Rebel Ships|Auto-ship]].
**{{Winning|destroyed=true|The ship explodes, leaving behind a substantial collection of useful scrap material.}}
***You receive medium [[Rewards#Destroying_the_ship|scrap with resources]].

==Notes==
This event is called "AUTO_SUN" in the datafiles.
